searchText: Hi, I have sent ETH to claim the KZG POAP on Friday, but not yet receiving it. How long does it usually take to the minting process? Ser, I must have completed all the steps and posted the tweet. 🫡 I was able to look up my wallet address in all of the earliest contributed data. But this time, I wonder why I'm not eligible for poap? so you're saying it was included in the transcript many months ago, but now it's not appearing in the transcript? can you share the original tweet from when you contributed? <CarlBeek> or ideally the `recipt.json` It seems like almost half a year has passed and I need to take the time to find the tweets! it should be pretty easy, just search your history for "KZG Ceremony" (though to be clear, this doesn't prove that you were actually included in the transcript. just makes it more likely you're sharing something that actually happened)
